verdicts.reason: Both are unusable in the same way. The dark green background didn't scale to fill the banner: the forest art is a narrow strip in the middle of a blank white canvas, the white text is invisible on the white, and the brand look is gone. In A, only a pale yellow 'March 21' at the left and a clipped 'Jo' from the subhead show, and the headline is missing. In B, only clipped headline fragments ('ed', 'y') show over the strip, next to an even tinier 'March 21'. Neither has a readable message or any intentional layout.
